question: According to the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index, among other countries India ranked ________ in 2018, up from the 54th rank in 2014.
solution:
The correct answer is __**44th**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 According to the World Bank’s Logistics Performance Index, India ranks** 44th in 2018** on a global level, up from **54th rank in 2014**.
 
 
• The Indian logistics sector is expected to grow at **8-10 per cent **above average and reach a target of **$215 billion by 2020**.
 
• Out of the total private equity investment into real** estate, 26%** of the investment is towards the warehousing sector.
 
• Propelling logistics costs down from projected current levels of **13-14 % of GDP to 10 %** in line with best-in-class international standards is essential for India to become globally competitive.
 
• **Germany ranks 1** on World Bank's Logistics Performance Index.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About World Bank**.

 
 
• The World Bank is like a cooperative, made up of **189 member countries**.
 
• The World Bank is an** international financial institution** that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• Headquarters-**Washington, D.C., United States**.
 
• Founded: **July 1944, Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, United States**.
 
• President:** David Malpass (As of August 2022)**.
